questionSnapshot.question: What name replaced Downtown Disney for Walt Disney World's shopping and dining district in 2015?

notes: Bound the question to the 2015 renaming instead of an unbounded current name. Similar shopping districts at other resorts do not answer a Walt Disney World renaming. All options have a parallel Disney/place form. 1145 asks the largest character store within the district, not this name change. Full topic digests, ranked comparisons, both category digests, and additional cross-bank title/name searches were read for distinctness; only this saved plan is in scope.
